commands.name: switch-windows-yabai
commands.title: Switch Windows (Yabai)
commands.description: Switch Windows extension similar to Native Raycast one but using Yabai. More actions to come

commands.name: load-scripting-addition
commands.title: Load Yabai Scripting Addition
commands.description: Run 'sudo yabai --load-sa' to load the yabai scripting addition (requires admin password)

preferences.name: yabaiPath
preferences.title: Yabai Executable Path
preferences.description: Path to the yabai executable. Leave empty for auto-detection (checks /opt/homebrew/bin/yabai, /usr/local/bin/yabai, then PATH).

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
